headline: Last minute charter deals
primaryText:
🌊 Last-Minute Escape
Spontaneous plans make the best memories. Choose your yacht, gather your crew, and set sail before the season slips away. ✨

Book your last-minute yacht charter today. ⛵
whyItWorks: The copy frames a last-minute booking as a fun, spontaneous choice rather than a rushed one, which lowers the hesitation around short notice. The line about the season slipping away adds a soft deadline that pushes people to act now. The vertical video opens on an airplane in the clouds, a travel cue that stops the scroll and signals a getaway.
